title_sq: Apartament 3+1 +2 tualete ne shitje ne Fresk (ID 4131361)
description_sq:
Ne Fresk, prane Residences Delta (5 min ne kembe nga Restorant Fresku), shitet apartament 3+1, Me Hipoteke, siperfaqa 162.3 m² , kati i 6-te ne nje pallat te ri me ashensor.
Apartamenti organizohet ne nje dhome ndenje me aneks gatimi, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete me dritare, ballkon, korridor shperndares te dhomave. Apartamenmti eshte i rikonstruktuar para 2 vitesh dhe mobiluar. Ndodhet ne nje zone shume te preferuar me te gjitha facilitete si kopesht, cerdhe, shkolle 9 vjecare, ambulance etc.
Cmimi 230 000 Euro
title_en: Apartment 3+1 +2 toilets for sale in Fresk (ID 4131361)
description_en: In Fresk, near Delta Residences (5 min walk from Fresku Restaurant), 3+1 apartment for sale, with mortgage, surface area 162.3 m², 6th floor in a new building with elevator. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms with windows, a balcony, a corridor that divides the rooms. The apartment was reconstructed 2 years ago and furnished. It is located in a very preferred area with all facilities such as kindergarten, kindergarten, 9-year-old school, ambulance, etc. The price is 230,000 Euros
